question.text: What is the gross open position limit for Standalone Primary Dealers (SPDs) in USD-INR contracts across all exchanges?

answer.text: 15% of the total open interest or USD 50 million, whichever is higher
15% of the total open interest or USD 100 million, whichever is higher
6% of the total open interest or USD 20 million, whichever is higher
15% of the total open interest or USD 200 million, whichever is higher

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 201, for SPDs in USD-INR the gross open position across all contracts shall not exceed 15 per cent of total open interest or USD 50 million, whichever is higher. The Trap: The USD 100 million figure does not apply to SPDs; it relates to other categories of participants. Note: Per page 162, the parallel category limits are USD 100 million for general trading members, USD 1 billion for authorized bank trading members, and USD 50 million for proprietary stock-brokers other than banks; SPDs have their own USD 50 million absolute cap from page 201.
